newsitem.title: USA: Goldman Sachs names managing directors, partners.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs names managing directors, partners.

text.p: Goldman Sachs & Co said on Tuesday that it has promoted 125 employees to managing director and another 38 to partner.
The managing director posts are newly created, since the firm needed an executive position between vice president and partner, Goldman Sachs said.
The appointments to partner are conducted every two years, the firm said.
The appointments are effective as of November 30, 1996, the start of the firm's fiscal year, it said.
The total number of partners for the firm was not immediately available.
